tools.name: get_service_status
tools.description: Look up the health, current version and replica count of a service.

tools.name: search_logs
tools.description: Search recent log lines of a service for a text pattern.

tools.name: trigger_deploy
tools.description: Start a deployment of a given version of a service.

tools.name: rollback_deploy
tools.description: Roll a service back to a previous deployment.

tools.name: restart_service
tools.description: Restart all instances of a service.

tools.name: scale_service
tools.description: Set the number of running replicas of a service.

tools.name: resolve_incident
tools.description: Mark an incident as resolved with a closing note.

tools.name: post_to_channel
tools.description: Post a message to an internal chat channel.

tools.name: grant_access
tools.description: Give a user a role on a resource.

tools.name: delete_resource
tools.description: Permanently delete a snapshot, volume, bucket or other cloud resource.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email from the platform team mailbox.
